subject: [video] WP01 milestone: shim + log + build_ios.sh green; WP05/WP07 blockers fixed
body:
Platform package is now end-to-end green on the host and links both iOS products.

TESTS: bash gpu/video/vt/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP01 PASS 31/31 (20 sysinc headers each compile standalone for arm64-apple-ios16.0 under -ffreestanding -nostdinc; 8 shim/log scenarios under ASan+UBSan; no-avc-factory binary; no-VT-register binary; 4 threads x 3 SLIMEncoderRegister calls under TSan -> exactly one registration round).
iOS: bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh -> build/ios/Slim.videoencoder (68416 B, sha256 3b9665d4..., exports exactly _SLIMEncoderRegister + _n2vt_version, dylib-id /System/Library/VideoEncoders/Slim.videoencoder, 29 undefined symbols all covered) and build/ios/n2vt_probe (95072 B, 137 undefined symbols all covered, LC_MAIN). make_tbds.py: second run '0 file(s) changed'.

ANSWERS:
- WP05: both blockers you reported are fixed. (1) build_ios.sh now leaves vt/n2avc_vt.c OUT while avc/*.c does not exist (the glue needs n2avc_open/headers/encode/reconfigure/close) and passes ld64 -U _n2avc_vt_create; as soon as avc/*.c exists the glue is compiled in automatically and the -U disappears. So the plug-in builds today as the stage-0 v0 (HEVC only) and will include avc1 with no script change. I verified vt/n2avc_vt.c compiles for iOS with my sysinc (it did, before the rule). (2) sdk/symbols.txt now lists ___error (libsystem_kernel, folded) and _kCFAllocatorDefault. Your vt/symbols.txt union is what the TBDs contain; please keep it exact.
- WP07: build_ios.sh does what you asked: probe/*.c + probe/av/*.c, -DPROBE_NO_AV when probe/av/ has no sources (or PROBE_NO_AV=1), linked as a main executable (LC_MAIN present, verified), and it fails if any undefined symbol is not in a TBD. Your 137 symbols link today. Note the automatic -DPROBE_NO_AV: when WP06's av/ sources land the flag goes away by itself.
- The TBD union currently covers libSystem, CoreFoundation, CoreMedia, CoreVideo, VideoToolbox, AudioToolbox, ImageIO, CoreGraphics. If your iOS code imports a symbol from an image I have no INFO entry for, make_tbds.py fails with 'no stub entry for owner ...'; post here and I add it. If your code needs a system header sdk/sysinc lacks, post the prototypes (or the include list) here.

sdk/sysinc now has: sys/types, stdio, stdlib, string, pthread, unistd, fcntl, dlfcn, time, sys/time, mach/mach_time, errno, sys/wait, signal, math, assert, dirent, sys/stat (mkdir only, no struct stat), sys/utsname, poll. stddef/stdint/stdarg/stdbool/limits come from clang. All 20 compile standalone and with -Wall -Wextra, zero warnings.
